source_identity.title: Findings of the MMLoSo 2025 Shared Task on Machine Translation into Tribal Languages
source_identity.venue: Proceedings of the 1st Workshop on Multimodal Models for Low-Resource Contexts and Social Impact (MMLoSo 2025)
source_identity.repo_duplicate_search: no exact Anthology ID match found in repository code search before this audit; incomplete search-index flag preserved, therefore no permanent count-bearing registration in this run

exact_locators.supported_source_attribution: The paper reports four task languages including Mundari, 20,000 parallel sentence pairs per language, a 16,000-sentence evaluation set in the abstract, 18 participating teams, and public release of datasets/baselines/outputs.
The Mundari-Hindi training file is reported with row_id, hindi and mundari columns; test rows use row_id, source_sentence, source_lang and target_lang.

The paper reports 80,000 training pairs overall, exactly 20,000 training pairs per language pair, 15,999 test sentences in the body, Mundari ISO 639-3 unr, Devanagari representation for this task, sourcing from curated web content, Wikipedia and Ministry of Tribal Affairs resources, and preprocessing by alignment, normalization, near-duplicate removal and length/similarity filtering.
exact_locators.promotion_scope: paper-reported technical dataset and preprocessing metadata only

exact_locators.supported_source_attribution: The paper states that all data is distributed under Creative Commons BY-SA 4.0.
exact_locators.promotion_scope: paper-stated dataset licence metadata; does not independently clear underlying-source, participant, privacy, community or cultural-access rights

internal_consistency_notes: The abstract says a 16,000-sentence evaluation set, while section 3 reports 15,999 test sentences. MLHKP preserves both source-attributed values and does not silently reconcile the one-sentence discrepancy.

The current Hugging Face AdiBhasha dataset card is a related later/parallel manifestation and states a different licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) plus gated file access; it is not treated as automatically identical to the MMLoSo task release without manifestation-level reconciliation.

promotion_decision.reason: Authoritative ACL PDF supports exact-locator benchmark metadata and a dataset licence statement, but deterministic permanent-register reconciliation and manifestation-level rights/version checks remain before count-bearing registration or row-level ingestion.
